title: Injectivity of paired coordinate indices
statement: For nonnegative integers $r,k$, the map from the disjoint union of two copies of $\{0,\ldots,k-1\}$ to $\{0,\ldots,r+2k-1\}$ that sends the first copy's index $j$ to $r+2j$ and the second copy's index $j$ to $r+2j+1$ is injective.
